segments.name: Healthcare analytics
segments.description: Provides subscription-based analytics, insights and workflow enablement solutions that measure and improve patient, consumer, employee and market experiences for healthcare organizations.
segments.evidence: The Company provides analytics and insight solutions designed to measure and improve patient and employee experience for healthcare organizations.

revenueModel.text: Healthcare organizations pay recurring subscription fees for the Company's experience management and insights solutions.
revenueModel.evidence: Our portfolio of subscription-based solutions provides actionable information, analysis, and workflow enablement tools to healthcare organizations across a range of mission-critical, constituent-related elements, including patient experience, service recovery, care transitions, employee engagement, reputation management, rounding, and brand loyalty.
